text:
The Miyajima torii doesn't always float. Below about 100 cm of tide you can walk right up to it, above about 250 cm it seems to rise out of the sea, and some days you get both 👇

👀 Which would you rather see: walking to its feet, or the floating view? Here's how to get the day you want 👉 https://japanbystation.com/hiroshima-miyajima-one-day

We built this day plan from the museum's, the ferry company's and the Miyajima Tourist Association's own pages.

🌅 START AT 7:30

The Peace Memorial Museum opens at 7:30 if you book the early slot online. Quiet rooms, and the Peace Park and A-Bomb Dome before the tour groups.

🚆 THEN THE FAST WAY TO THE ISLAND

JR Sanyo Line to Miyajimaguchi in about 25–30 minutes, then a 10-minute ferry for ¥200. All covered by the JR Pass. The tram is ¥240, but it takes about 70–75 minutes.

🌊 LET THE TIDE PLAN YOUR AFTERNOON

The Tourist Association's tide table tells you when the water drops below 100 cm (walk to the torii) or rises above 250 cm (the floating view). Pick a day with both in daylight.

🍱 AND EAT LIKE THE COAST

Conger eel over rice a minute from Miyajimaguchi Station, then okonomiyaki in town at Okonomi-mura, 23 counters in one building.
